title: One idea per teaching piece
statement: Give each short teaching piece exactly one idea: something that can be stated as a single testable sentence.
example: A well-sized idea can be explained in under 60 words and tested by a single multiple-choice question.
detail: The evaluator's check for short instructional video scripts treats one knowledge component per video as critical: an idea that can't be stated as a single testable proposition is likely two (`shadow-bench/src/inceptbench/prompts/video_script/evaluation.txt`). Its test asks whether two independent multiple-choice questions could be written from the script, each on a different core concept, with a student able to answer one without knowing the other. A well-sized idea can be expressed in under 60 words and tested by a single question.
against: Depth within one idea is allowed: '- Explaining all steps of a single multi-step process (depth within one KC is allowed)' (`shadow-bench/src/inceptbench/prompts/video_script/evaluation.txt`, line 252).

evidence.quote: If a KC cannot be stated as a single testable proposition, it is likely two KCs.

**The two-MCQ test:** Could you write two independent MCQs from this script, each testing a different core concept, where a student could answer one without knowing the other? If yes, the script is teaching two KCs.
**What this checks:** Whether the script teaches exactly one KC — one idea that can be expressed in under 60 words and tested by a single MCQ.
- Explaining all steps of a single multi-step process (depth within one KC is allowed)
